tokens.name: paper
tokens.usage: Page background behind every screen.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the sentence panel on the shadowing screen.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Pressed rows, progress-bar track, empty blanks in the review hint.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and English sentences on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Korean translations, captions and secondary labels on paper, surface and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and card edges. Decorative only; never the only cue for a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: 2px rules under screen titles and the outline of secondary buttons (3:1+ on every surface).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Signal blue: primary buttons, matched words, progress fill, the mic button. One meaning only: 'go / done'.

tokens.name: accent-press
tokens.usage: Pressed state of accent fills.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Quiet blue ground: today's lesson card, selected rows. Text on it uses ink or accent-ink.

tokens.name: accent-ink
tokens.usage: Blue text and links on paper, surface and accent-tint.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on accent and accent-press fills.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Wrong words and destructive actions, as text on surface and danger-tint. Always paired with a wavy underline or an icon.

tokens.name: danger-tint
tokens.usage: Ground behind a wrong word.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus ring with 2px offset, on every surface.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Segoe UI", "Malgun Gothic", system-ui, sans-serif
families.mono: ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, "Apple SD Gothic Neo", "Malgun Gothic", monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen: the screen title.

styles.name: sentence
styles.sample: I'm gonna grab a coffee. Wanna come?
styles.usage: The English sentence on shadowing, variation and review screens.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: Streak days and big counts. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Totally. Let me just grab my jacket.
styles.usage: English running text: tutor notes, role-play lines.

styles.name: body-kr
styles.sample: 커피 한잔하러 갈 건데, 같이 갈래?
styles.usage: Korean translations and notes. Pair with word-break: keep-all.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Meta lines under rows and controls.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows over titles: course and lesson position, step names.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a word block and the next.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon to label, eyebrow to title.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between stacked controls in a group.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on iPhone, card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between cards; card padding on iPad.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between screen sections; iPad side gutter.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Above the screen title.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large breathing room around the shadowing sentence.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Rules, progress bars, the screen grid.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, word blocks, blanks, inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards and sheets.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Toggle track and thumb, the round mic button.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height and width of anything tappable (Apple HIG).

tokens.name: mic-size
tokens.usage: Diameter of the mic button on the shadowing screen.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Bottom tab bar height, before the home-indicator safe area.

tokens.name: rule-weight
tokens.usage: Thickness of line-strong rules and secondary-button outlines.

tokens.name: progress-height
tokens.usage: Thickness of the progress bar.

tokens.name: column-list
tokens.usage: Width of the left list column in the iPad two-column layout.

tokens.name: bp-ipad
tokens.usage: From this viewport width, switch to two columns. Write the number in media queries: CSS variables do not work inside them.
